BNB.summary: There is no direct BNB catalyst yet. BNB lost the $750 area on Oct 15 under macro pressure, which puts it just below the long's ~738 level. The 37th quarterly auto-burn was expected mid-October but had not been confirmed as of Oct 14 and is the near-term event to watch. The BNB Chain zero-fee stablecoin promo ends Oct 31.

news.title: Binance will close Binance Pool and its cloud-mining services on Nov 10
Zero-fee USDC/USD1 transfers on BNB Chain run until Oct 31; 37th burn expected but not yet dated
BNB falls below the $750 pivot as hot US CPI weighs on crypto
Binance.US reportedly seeks up to $100M at about a $1B valuation

SKR.summary: SKR is trading near $0.0140, just under the long's 0.0146 level, and is down about 15% this week despite the Ledger Atom news. A 100M SKR community unlock (about 1% of total supply) is due Oct 21, two days out, with further monthly unlocks on the 21st.

news.title: Solana Mobile adds Ledger Atom support to the Seeker ecosystem
Seeker app integrates with Ledger Atom as SOL falls about 8%
Solana Mobile blog post on SKR distribution on Seeker

unlock.note: Community. Listed as about 1.0% of total supply and 1.5% of market cap (no circulating % stated); next listed unlock Nov 21.

TRX.summary: For the long near 0.332, the supportive items are Tron Inc.'s planned $200M stock sale (mostly to buy TRX) and record Q3 stablecoin settlement. Working against it, TRX supply has grown on net every day since July 1, so the token is mildly inflationary for now.

news.title: Nasdaq-listed Tron Inc. files to sell up to $200M of stock, mainly to buy TRX
TRON settled $2.2T in stablecoins in Q3; USDT/USDD on TRON near $94B
TRX supply has risen on net for 108 straight days despite stablecoin growth

HBAR.summary: For the short near 0.0856, recent news is slow institutional adoption (Taurus giving banks such as Deutsche Bank HBAR staking; a UK tokenization taskforce seat) that has not shown up in price. The spot ETF had small outflows. No unlock found.

news.title: Taurus brings the full Hedera stack, including HBAR staking, to bank clients such as Deutsche Bank
Canary HBR spot HBAR ETF posts about $559K outflow amid broad crypto ETF withdrawals
Hedera named to UK Wholesale Digital Markets taskforce; TVL up about 12% over 30 days

LDO.summary: For the long near 0.414, the NEST buyback has not bought any LDO yet: its revenue counter was about -$564K on Oct 13, so buyback support is not active. Positives are LDO's inclusion in Grayscale's new DeFi fund and the Lido Lend work. No unlock is listed for the window.

news.title: Lido DAO debates changing NEST buyback thresholds; no LDO purchases funded yet
Grayscale DeFi Fund launched with Republic holds LDO alongside UNI and AAVE
Contributors propose 'Fallback Exits' safety feature for Lido Lend, pending DAO vote

LTC.summary: LTC had no meaningful fundamental news this week. It is trading around $60, just below the short's 62.7 level, after a weak-volume bounce on Oct 16. Litecoin has no vesting, so there is no unlock to track.

news.title: Lite Strategy launches a 'Proof of Time' archive for Litecoin's 15th anniversary

FET.summary: No FET-specific catalyst Oct 12-19. The long depends on broad AI-sector and risk sentiment after the mid-October AI-token selloff. No unlock found.

APT.summary: For the long, the investor and contributor vesting schedule has ended, cutting monthly new supply by about 60% to roughly 4.54M APT. Mainnet upgrades (privacy features, encrypted mempool, Block-STM v2) also give the long a positive story. The next unlock, on Nov 11, is small and goes to the community and foundation.

news.title: Aptos four-year investor/contributor unlock schedule ends, monthly issuance drops sharply
Keyless Accounts, Confidential APT and Encrypted Mempool go live on Aptos mainnet
Encrypted mempool enabled on mainnet to curb MEV, with Petra Wallet the first to support it
Aptos turns on Block-STM v2 parallel execution by default on mainnet

unlock.note: Monthly community/foundation release; investor and contributor vesting has ended. Tokenomist dates it; ~4.54M is the new monthly level. Some sources say Nov 12.

SEI.summary: For the long, the main near-term event is the REX-Osprey staked SEI ETF, whose filing sets Oct 23 as the effective date. Trading still depends on SEC review. The Oct 15 unlock (about 0.84% of circulating) has already passed; the next ecosystem-reserve release is Nov 15.

news.title: REX-Osprey amends staked SEI ETF filing, proposing an Oct 23 effective date
Monthly unlock of ~55.56M SEI (~0.84% of circulating) passes as SEI jumps ~11% in a day
Sei Giga roadmap says the Autobahn consensus upgrade is coming soon, with no date

unlock.note: Monthly Ecosystem Reserve release. Tokenomist dates it but gives no amount; the Oct 15 tranche was about 55.56M SEI.

OP.summary: For the short near 0.133, the main upside risk is the Unichain move to OP Enterprise (mainnet cutover Oct 29) plus expected buybacks from Feb 2027; OP is up about 66% over four weeks. No confirmed unlock in the window (DefiLlama shows a small 0.19% Seed Fund unlock Dec 1, but Tokenomist says Jan 10).

news.title: OP jumps 18% as Unichain moves to OP Enterprise and Upgrade 20 buybacks are priced in

INJ.summary: For the short near 8.55, INJ just jumped about 27-30% to a one-year high above $9-10 after the CEO met US policymakers. The pending 21Shares, Canary and REX-Osprey staked INJ ETF filings are the main squeeze risk. No unlocks.

news.title: INJ jumps about 27% to a one-year high on Washington meetings and pending staked-ETF filings
INJ extends rally as Injective CEO meets US policymakers on tokenization
Injective surges 30% on White House talks and a new institutional validator, breaking $10

GRASS.summary: For the short, the key event is the Oct 28 contributor cliff, about 31.58M GRASS or roughly 4.5% of circulating supply. That is a supply overhang about 9 days out. I found no news newer than the Contents API launch.

news.title: Grass launches Contents API that turns live web pages into AI-ready data

unlock.note: Contributors (team) cliff after a one-year lock-up extension. Date confirmed by Tokenomist; amount from DropsTab only.

ONDO.summary: For the long, Ondo reports TVL above $4B, more than $1.3B in tokenized stocks and ETFs, and over 1M holders. Against that, DWF Labs data shows Ondo's share of tokenized equities falling to about 26% as Binance bStocks and xStocks gain. There is no unlock in the window; the next is Jan 18, 2027.

news.title: IMF warns of low liquidity and volatility in tokenized stocks, a market where Ondo dominates
Ondo says TVL passed $4B, with tokenized stocks and ETFs above $1.3B
DWF Labs: Ondo's tokenized-equity share falls from 56% to 26% as rivals grow

IO.summary: I found no IO-specific news dated Oct 12-19, so the short has no fresh driver either way. The main scheduled event is a monthly unlock of about 15.86M IO (2% of total supply) on Nov 11, which goes mostly to private investors and insiders.

unlock.note: Monthly tranche split among Private Investors (~47.6%), Community (~35.2%) and Insiders (~17.2%). Tokenomist gives the same date. Listed as 2% of total supply; no circulating % stated.

ETH.summary: For the long near 2371, ETF demand is still the weak spot: spot ETH funds lost about $542M in one week and outflows continued into mid-October. Schwab's retail spot ETH access is a slow, structural source of demand. No unlocks.

news.title: Charles Schwab widens retail spot ETH trading access
US spot Ether ETFs shed about $542M in a week, led by BlackRock ETHA outflows
Spot BTC and ETH ETFs record $1.2B combined weekly outflows
